name: add-to-agent-context
description: Copies the active file's full path with the selected line range, or adds it straight into a coding agent's context.

commands.title: Add Path With Line Selection to Agent

addToAgentContext.selectionPopup.description: Show a popup with a button for each available agent and a "Copy to clipboard" button after selecting text with the mouse, and when hovering over selected text
addToAgentContext.selectionPopup.markdownDescription: Show a popup next to the cursor after selecting text with the mouse (except when double-clicking a word), and when hovering over selected text. It has an **Add to _agent_** button for each available agent and a **Copy to clipboard** button.

addToAgentContext.agents.description: Agents that can receive the path with line selection, keyed by agent id
addToAgentContext.agents.markdownDescription: Agent extensions that `addToAgentContext.sendToAgent`, `addToAgentContext.pickAction` and `addToAgentContext.pickFileAction` can target, keyed by a stable agent id (used to remember the last agent you sent to, and passed as `args` to `sendToAgent`). Your entries are merged with the defaults: add a new key to add an agent, set only the fields you want to change on an existing one, or set it to `null` to remove it. Each entry needs a `command`, and is shown by its `label`, or its id when no label is set. Set `fileCommand` to also offer the agent for files and folders selected in the explorer. An agent whose extension is missing, or whose command is no longer registered, is reported as unavailable instead of silently doing nothing.

label.description: Name shown in the destination picker; defaults to the agent id

extensionId.description: Publisher-qualified extension id, checked to tell 'not installed' from 'command renamed'

command.description: Command that adds the current editor selection to the agent's context

fileCommand.description: Command that adds a file or folder to the agent's context, called with its URI
fileCommand.markdownDescription: Command that adds a file or folder to the agent's context. Called once per item selected in the explorer, with that item's URI as the only argument. Agents without it are not offered by `addToAgentContext.pickFileAction`.
